Long before surface settlements took root, ancient civilizations flourished in the deep underground. Carving great halls from dark slate and sculk, their scholars sought mastery over the boundary between life, death, and matter.

From their rites emerged artifacts that defied nature—calcified eyes imbued with consciousness, and spectral sentinels sworn by ancient oaths to guard their masters' possessions into the afterlife.

When catastrophe buried the deep cities, their relics were swallowed by the earth, mineralizing into rare deposits of §5Mysterious Stone§r. When you first opened your eyes in this world, one of those ancient watchers was already beside you.
